itinerary.title: Paragliding in Fethiye
itinerary.text:
Paragliding in Fethiye
Babadag (Father Mountain) towering above the magnificent Oludeniz on the Southwest coast of Turkey is considered one of the best flying points in the world for paragliding. A geological marvel and a "world heritage" site, due to its rich flora, Babadag just happens to have incredible thermals and ideal conditions for paragliding flights.
Standart Tandem Flight is the most common service on demand. Anybody, without any paragliding experience, can enjoy the paragliding sport and the perfect view of Ölüdeniz. All you do is sit comfortably in the harness and tell the pilot where to go and what to do (steady glide, spiral dives, thermaling, etc.).
Fun: Without doubt, all the Reaction Paragliding passengers experience an intense and fun adventure. 2000m / 6600 feet altitude is more than enough. You can thermal even higher. The quiet glide above the beautiful landscape will be breath taking.
Flight Duration: The flight is 20-45 minutes. It is the passenger to define the duration by choosing a steady glide or thermaling.
What to bring: Sun glasses, trainie shoes or boots is enough. Flight suits are provided by Reaction.
Let us explain how Reaction Paragliding attains safe paragliding operations...
Safety is guarantied by controling the 4 main parameters; meteorological conditions, pilot skills, pilot fatique and equipment.
Meteorolojical Conditions: The major parameter of safety in paragliding is the weather. The approach of Reaction Paragliding, to ensure safe operations, is to stay on the ground when the conditions are close or above the limits. Our pilots will not take off when all safe conditions are not guarantied.
Pilot Skills: All of the pilots working for Reaction Paragliding has more than 5 years of continious experience as a commercial tandem pilot. Please check pilot profiles.
Pilot Fatique: Our pilots have day off whenever they want. This attains no fatique and physical stress on pilots. Reaction is the only tandem paragliding company applying frequent (min. one day per week) day off to pilots in Ölüdeniz.

faqs.q: What is included in the Fethiye Paragliding Adventure?
faqs.a: The Fethiye Paragliding Adventure includes a tandem paragliding flight with a licensed professional pilot from the famous Babadağ Mountain above Ölüdeniz. The experience includes safety equipment, a pre-flight briefing, transportation to the launch site, and a breathtaking flight over one of Turkey's most spectacular coastal landscapes.

faqs.q: How much does the Fethiye Paragliding Adventure cost?
faqs.a: The paragliding experience starts from €180 per person for the 2026 season. Prices may vary depending on travel dates, seasonal demand, and weather conditions. Advance booking is recommended, particularly during the busy summer months.

faqs.q: How long does the paragliding flight last?
faqs.a: The flight typically lasts between 45 minutes and 1 hour, depending on weather and wind conditions. Including hotel pickup, transportation to Babadağ Mountain, preparation, and briefing, the entire experience usually takes around 3 to 4 hours.

faqs.q: Do I need previous paragliding experience?
faqs.a: No previous experience is required. This is a tandem flight, meaning you fly with a fully licensed and experienced pilot who controls the paraglider throughout the entire flight. First-time participants are welcome.

faqs.q: Is hotel pickup and drop-off included?
faqs.a: Yes, hotel pickup and drop-off are generally included for accommodations within the Fethiye and Ölüdeniz area. Transportation to the Babadağ launch site is arranged as part of the experience.

Yes, tandem paragliding in Fethiye is operated by licensed pilots following strict safety regulations. All equipment is regularly inspected, and flights only take place when weather and wind conditions are suitable for safe flying.

faqs.q: What should I wear for the paragliding flight?
faqs.a: Comfortable clothing, sports shoes or closed-toe shoes, and sunglasses are recommended. Depending on the season, a light jacket may be useful, as temperatures can be cooler at the mountain launch site than at sea level.

faqs.q: What can I see during the flight?
faqs.a: During your flight, you will enjoy panoramic views of Ölüdeniz Blue Lagoon, Butterfly Valley, Babadağ Mountain, the Mediterranean coastline, surrounding islands, and the turquoise waters that make Fethiye one of the world's top paragliding destinations.

faqs.q: What happens if the flight is canceled due to weather?
faqs.a: Paragliding is weather dependent and may be canceled if wind or weather conditions are unsuitable. In such cases, you will usually be offered an alternative flight time, a different date, or a full refund according to the operator's policy.

faqs.q: When is the best time of year for paragliding in Fethiye?
faqs.a: Paragliding operates from spring through autumn, with the most popular months being April through October. Summer offers clear skies and spectacular coastal views, while spring and autumn provide comfortable temperatures and excellent flying conditions.
